dictation.commandsHint: While talking you can say: next · skip · go back · stop.
dictation.denied: Microphone access is blocked, so you can type instead. To use your voice, allow the microphone for this site in your browser settings.
dictation.error: Voice typing stopped. You can try again, or type instead.
dictation.langError: Your browser can't listen in this language. Voice fill stopped — you can switch the page language or keep typing.
dictation.privacy: Your browser (Apple or Google) turns speech into text. Mind at Ease Solutions only receives the text you keep.
dictation.unsupported: Voice typing isn't available in this browser. Type instead, or use the microphone key on your phone's keyboard.
dictation.walkDone: All set — check everything, then tap the button below to finish. Nothing has been sent yet.
dictation.walkPrompt: {{label}} — speak now, or say “next” to skip.
dictation.walkStopped: Voice fill stopped. Nothing has been sent — check the form, then finish by tapping the button yourself.
